environment.description: Deployed on EC2 behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with no application-layer inspection. The Flask app is exposed directly on port 8080 via target group. Celery workers run on the same instance with Redis accessible on localhost. No rate limiting configured. The /api/v2/webhooks/result endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication, allowing attackers to poll task results and observe padding error vs JSON error responses to mount a padding oracle attack.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (Layer 4 only, no payload inspection)
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080
